magpie.description: Magpie's MCP hub: the servers its library keeps (context7 library docs, image vision) behind one endpoint.

fast-context.description: Semantic code search across the current repository.

onenote.description: Reads and edits the Windows OneNote desktop client from WSL. Writes are two steps: a dry run issues an applyToken, then the same call with dryRun=false applies it.

kaze.description: Controls the Kaze browser on Windows from WSL: tabs, navigation, page observation and site adapters.
